a: Good morning in Pidgin is often How far or Good morning.
I dey means I am / I'm around.
Gist means news, story, or gossip.
Shine eye can mean be alert or ambitious depending on context.
Soft life means an easy, comfortable lifestyle.
Japa means to leave the country, often for better opportunities.
Sabi means to know or be skilled at something.
Correct can mean good, proper, or okay.
